```
['create a MeshRCNNMapper instance with cfg, is_train flag, and dataset_names to apply image and mesh transformations', 'transform a dataset_dict by reading the image, applying resize and flip transforms, and preparing instances', 'build an Instances object from annotation dicts containing bboxes, classes, masks, voxels, and meshes', 'load unique OBJ mesh models from a JSON annotation file and model root directory into memory', 'process a mesh by transforming vertices to camera coordinates and applying horizontal flip or resize transforms']
```
